text: The clinic is next to Big C Daokhanong. If you're driving, you can park nearby. Today I came for teeth cleaning and a dental check-up. I asked the dentist a few questions and they answered well, but I didn't see them examine my teeth very closely. The teeth cleaning was very quick, probably less than five minutes. Then the dentist said to come back in a year for another cleaning. The teeth cleaning cost 1050 baht. I could use my social security insurance for 900 baht, so I had to pay an additional 150 baht. However, I didn't feel very satisfied with the service. At other clinics, the dentist would examine my teeth, clean the teeth, and then apply fluoride. This time, it was so quick that I wondered if the cleaning was truly finished.
